Points to note:
1. The upstream version is behind the Fedora sources version.  
2. The Upstream also says that the project is Inactive(See "Inactive projects" section of https://www.freedesktop.org/wiki/Software/).

On 23 Oct it was decided that we will upgrade it to 0.2.20080216.2.
Despite the upstream being inactive (See "Inactive projects section of "https://www.freedesktop.org/wiki/Software/"), we are not removing it because removing a font package may have some effects like other packages depend upon it.

On Upstream (as seen on github) 45 seems to be the latest stable release.  46~beta is not the stable release.

Therefore, instead of 46~beta from Fedora sources we must use 45 from the upstream on github.
